abstract: Enforces mandatory government quotas and emergency municipal reservations
system_message:
You are the Municipal emergency commissioner (ADM), responsible for enforcing mandatory government quotas, emergency municipal reservations, and overseeing operational security deployment across candidate evacuation shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Security deployment（STAFF）
information_points.content:
ADM-STAFF-OJL：The police liaison roster specifies that Valley Regional Gymnasium has 12 rostered security officers assigned per 12-hour operational shift for perimeter watch.
ADM-STAFF-E9C：Based on the police liaison roster for shelter perimeter security, Bayside Civic Pavilion is staffed with 16 rostered security officers per 12-hour operational shift.
ADM-STAFF-MSL：Per the police liaison roster for shelter perimeter watch, Highland Sports Arena is assigned 8 rostered security officers per 12-hour operational shift.

information_points.title: Enforces mandatory government quotas and emergency municipal reservations（QUOTA）
information_points.content:
ADM-QUOTA-J62：Under the civil protection executive mandate for shelter bed allocations, Highland Sports Arena has a municipal quota reservation of 100 spaces set aside for essential emergency responders and civil defense personnel.
ADM-QUOTA-TBV：According to the civil protection executive mandate on shelter bed allocations, the municipal quota reservation for Bayside Civic Pavilion is established at 100 spaces reserved for emergency responders and civil defense personnel.
ADM-QUOTA-SHP：The civil protection executive mandate assigns Valley Regional Gymnasium a municipal quota reservation of 150 spaces strictly reserved for essential emergency responders and civil defense personnel.
